SELECT a.id as activityId, a.title as activityTitle, COALESCE(ac.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, COALESCE(u.username, '未知') as organizerName, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as startTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as endTime, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.id) as totalRegistrations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) as approvedRegistrations, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as checkinCount, a.max_participants as maxParticipants, a.status, COALESCE(SUM(c.actual_service_hours), 0) as totalServiceHours, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END), 2) ELSE 0 END as completionRate, CASE WHEN a.max_participants > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) * 100.0 / a.max_participants, 2) ELSE 0 END as registrationRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(c.actual_service_hours) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END), 2) ELSE 0 END as avgServiceHours FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN activity_registration ar ON a.id = ar.activity_id AND ar.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN activity_checkin c ON a.id = c.activity_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0
AND a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{activityTitle}, '%')
AND YEAR(a.start_time) = #{year}
GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.category_id, a.organizer_id, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.max_participants, a.status ORDER BY a.start_time DESC

SELECT a.id as activityId, a.title as activityTitle, COALESCE(ac.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, COALESCE(u.username, '未知') as organizerName, DATE_FORMAT(a.start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as startTime, DATE_FORMAT(a.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as endTime, COUNT(DISTINCT ar.id) as totalRegistrations, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) as approvedRegistrations, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as checkinCount, a.max_participants as maxParticipants, a.status, COALESCE(SUM(c.actual_service_hours), 0) as totalServiceHours, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END), 2) ELSE 0 END as completionRate, CASE WHEN a.max_participants > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) * 100.0 / a.max_participants, 2) ELSE 0 END as registrationRate, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM(c.actual_service_hours) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ar.status = 2 THEN ar.id END), 2) ELSE 0 END as avgServiceHours FROM activity a LEFT JOIN activity_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.organizer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN activity_registration ar ON a.id = ar.activity_id AND ar.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN activity_checkin c ON a.id = c.activity_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{activityId} AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.id, a.title, a.category_id, a.organizer_id, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.max_participants, a.status

SELECT vu.id as userId, vu.username as username, vu.real_name as realName, vu.phone as phone, COALESCE(SUM(ac.actual_service_hours), 0) as totalServiceHours, COALESCE(vu.star_level, 0) as starLevel FROM volunteer_user vu INNER JOIN activity_checkin ac ON vu.id = ac.user_id AND ac.deleted = 0 AND ac.actual_service_hours IS NOT NULL AND ac.actual_service_hours > 0 WHERE vu.deleted = 0 AND vu.status = 1
AND vu.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND vu.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND vu.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND YEAR(ac.checkin_time) = #{year}
GROUP BY vu.id, vu.username, vu.real_name, vu.phone, vu.star_level HAVING totalServiceHours > 0 ORDER BY totalServiceHours DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ranking FROM ( SELECT vu.id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sr.service_hours), 0) DESC) as ranking FROM volunteer_user vu LEFT JOIN service_record sr ON vu.id = sr.user_id AND sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.status = 1 AND YEAR(sr.service_date) = #{year} WHERE vu.deleted = 0 AND vu.status = 1 GROUP BY vu.id HAVING SUM(sr.service_hours) > 0 ) ranked WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT vu.id as userId, vu.real_name as realName, vu.star_level as starLevel, COALESCE(SUM(sr.service_hours), 0) as totalServiceHours, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.id) as activityCount, COALESCE(vu.total_points, 0) as totalPoints, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.service_date) as serviceDays FROM volunteer_user vu LEFT JOIN service_record sr ON vu.id = sr.user_id AND sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.status = 1 AND YEAR(sr.service_date) = #{year} WHERE vu.id = #{userId} GROUP BY vu.id, vu.real_name, vu.total_points, vu.star_level

SELECT vu.id as userId, vu.username, vu.real_name as realName, vu.phone, ac.category_name as categoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) as activityCount FROM volunteer_user vu INNER JOIN activity_checkin ac_checkin ON vu.id = ac_checkin.user_id AND ac_checkin.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN activity a ON ac_checkin.activity_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN activity_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id AND ac.deleted = 0 WHERE vu.deleted = 0 AND vu.status = 1
AND vu.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND vu.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND vu.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND YEAR(ac_checkin.checkin_time) = #{year}
GROUP BY vu.id, vu.username, vu.real_name, vu.phone, ac.category_name, ac.id ORDER BY vu.username, ac.category_name
